gaps.explanation: Re-read pp3-4 and 8-13 (trim has 13 pages). p4 prints four governmental columns (General Fund, Special Roads, COVID American Rescue Plan Fund, Non-major Funds) and each has a cash-basis budget schedule fully in detail (General p8, Special Roads p10, ARPA p11, All Non-Major Special Revenue Funds p12; p13 by-fund receipts 17,782,951 = p12 revenues 12,093,207 + transfers in 5,689,744, so not added; nonmajor balance-sheet cash 7,676,106 = p12/p13 ending balance, so no nonmajor fund lacks a schedule). Nothing counted twice. Per fund, schedule (cash) vs statement (modified accrual): General 84,720,509 vs 84,702,094 (+18,415); Special Roads 22,482,335 vs 20,662,496 (+1,819,839); ARPA 18,180,314 vs 14,002,672 (+4,177,642; GAAP recognizes ARPA revenue only as spent, p3 unavailable revenues 22,257,956); Non-major 12,093,207 vs 13,653,900 (-1,560,693). 18,415 + 1,819,839 + 4,177,642 - 1,560,693 = 4,455,203 = schedule above statement. JSON statement receipts 133,021,162 = p4 Total revenues (correct).

No column or row missing, nothing duplicated; the cash budget schedules exclude bond-escrow spending that the modified-accrual statement includes. Per fund, statement p4 vs schedule: General 102,648,630 vs p9 Total expenditures paid 74,555,888 (-28,092,742; p4 General capital outlay 33,666,598 vs p8 Capital Projects 1,889,216; p9 'Reconciliation to balance sheet' prints Disbursements of cash from escrow account for construction (21,460,132) and for issuance costs (149,500), and p4 prints Lease financing 557,054 (non-cash); these reconciliation rows are not budget-schedule expenditure lines and do not by themselves make up the 28,092,742, so they are not added); Special Roads 64,327,409 vs p10 32,163,694 (-32,163,715; p4 capital outlay 52,480,989 vs p10 Capital outlays 19,916,709, bond-financed construction from the Series 2021/2022 highway allocation bonds; p10 reconciliation prints only escrow proceeds 5,946,158 and interest 14,644, no spending figure); ARPA 13,802,237 vs p11 13,786,923 (-15,314 = p3 ARPA accounts payable 15,314); Non-major 19,274,950 vs p12 19,871,373 (+596,423). -28,092,742 - 32,163,715 - 15,314 + 596,423 = -59,675,348 = gap. JSON statement disbursements 200,053,226 = p4 Total expenditures (correct).

Detail has the gross 'Operating transfer in' rows of each cash schedule: General 22,000 (p9), Special Roads 3,150,000 (p10), Non-Major 5,689,744 (p12) = 8,861,744. p4 prints General 400,641, Special Roads 3,692,805, Non-major 5,648,244 = 9,741,690. Differences +378,641, +542,805, -41,500 = 879,946. Same funds, different printed amounts on the two bases; adding the p4 cells would count the same transfers twice.

Detail: General (9,417,000) (p9), ARPA (200,435) (p11), Non-Major (794,744) (p12) = 10,412,179. p4: General (9,918,305), ARPA (200,435), Non-major (1,173,385) = 11,292,125. Differences 501,305 + 0 + 378,641 = 879,946 (equal to the transfers-in difference). Same funds, different printed amounts on the two bases; nothing missing.
